_comment: Intended branch-protection ruleset for the `main` branch of raibid-labs/docs. This file is the source of truth for the policy. It CANNOT take effect on its own — a repository admin must apply it via the GitHub UI (Settings -> Branches) or with the GitHub API (see scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh). Required status check 'contexts' are the job `name:` values from .github/workflows/docs-lint.yml.
